CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #1
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Pollute rivers deliberately
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Destroy trees without planting
   D. Waste food daily

2. Which response best shows understanding of Journey to Jerusalem True Discipleship? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Journey to Jerusalem True Discipleship with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Journey to Jerusalem True Discipleship has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Journey to Jerusalem True Discipleship to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Journey to Jerusalem True Discipleship.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Methods of Studying the Holy Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Methods of Studying the Holy Bible.
   B. Use Methods of Studying the Holy Bible to insult classmates of other faiths.

   D. Say Methods of Studying the Holy Bible has no place in daily life.

   A. Hiding stolen items
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Spreading rumours

10. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Refusing to help a neighbour
   B. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   C. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Growth of the Church in Kenya and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
